name: Noxe Pixel Engine — 3D dioramas rendered as pixel art (three.js)
summary: MIT-licensed browser engine that renders procedural three.js dioramas as pixel art (toon lighting, outlines, dithered palette, pixel-snapped ortho camera), with time of day, weather (rain, storm, snow, fog), planar reflections, synthesized ambient sound, and offline 60 fps MP4 export with audio (16:9 up to 4K, square, portrait). No build step; ships 8+ scenes.

access.notes: Keep MIT notice. MP4 export needs Chrome/Edge (WebCodecs). Live demo at pixel.noxestudio.com.

procedure: Try the live demo at https://pixel.noxestudio.com/ (Chrome or Edge on desktop).
cd noxe-pixel-engine && python3 tools/serve.py, then open http://localhost:5184
Keys 1-4 time of day, 5-0 weather, G renders the demo clip to MP4, P saves a PNG.

stats.count: 8+ scenes (Alpine, Streetcar, Studio, Ferry, Campsite, Lookout, Motel, Cove)

verdict.why: Fresh open-sourcing (repo created Nov 5, opened Nov 8), polished pixel-art look and built-in MP4 export, MIT. Young project with ~20 stars.

image.alt: Pixel-art isometric alpine diorama: mountains, waterfall, lake with reflections, cabin with campfire and pine forest
